name: Hobgoblin

abilityDetails.Incinerate: While active, deals Energy Damage, reduces Block Proficiency by 50%, and removes Perfect Block chance.
abilityDetails.Instinct: Allows the Parry Mastery to trigger its Stun against non-contact attacks.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Allows the Parry Mastery to trigger its Stun against non-contact attacks.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: While active, Unblockable Attacks can be blocked as though they weren't.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Reduces Energy Resistance by the given potency, which increases incoming Energy Damage from Attacks and Abilities.
abilityDetails.Unblockable: Attacks cannot be blocked. Note that some attacks cannot be blocked, despite not having the actual Unblockable status.
abilityDetails.Stun: Prevent a champion from moving, attacking or defending, leaving them vulnerable to an attack.

signatureAbility:
Goblin Knight
Start each fight with 3 Maniacal Charges.
Lunatic Laugh reduces the expiry rate of personal Steadfast and non-Damaging Debuffs by [17 - 50]%.
Hobgoblin's Energy Vulnerability gains +[0.8 - 15]% flat potency.

abilitySections.title: Sword and Serum
content: Hobgoblin's perfected Goblin Serum grants him full Immunity to Poison.
Any repeated Light or Medium Attack in a chain of attacks inflicts an Incinerate Debuff dealing [3,989.2] Energy Damage over 40 seconds.
After Hobgoblin Glances, his flaming sword inflicts a personal Incinerate Debuff. Cooldown: 1 second.
This Goblin isn't so easily shaken. Incoming Deliriums have their durations reduced by 10% per Maniacal Charge. Max: 90%.

abilitySections.title: Maniacal - Max: 30
content: Hobgoblin's crazed nature allows him to gain Maniacal Charges lasting 7 seconds, paused while charging a Heavy Attack and during the Opponent's Special Attacks. These expire one at a time and are refreshed when gaining a new one.
His third Light Attack grants +1 Maniacal Charge.
Preventing a Regeneration effect from healing with Heal Block, or Well-Timed Blocking an Unblockable attack with Steadfast grants +1 Maniacal Charge. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
While at 10 or greater Maniacal Charges, gain an indefinite Instinct Passive. Against Mutants, this threshold is 5 or greater.

abilitySections.title: Lunatic Laugh
content: Hobgoblin's Heavy Attack can be charged for an extended duration.

Charging Hobgoblin's Heavy Attack for 0.5 seconds performs a Lunatic Laugh which rattles the Opponent for 10 seconds, increasing the tick rate of personal Damaging effects on them by 250%. The Laugh remains paused while Heavy charging.
Activating a Special Attack 1 or 2 while charging or shortly after starting a Heavy Attack increases the Laugh's tick rate increase of personal Damaging effects to 500%.

abilitySections.title: My Own Bag of Tricks - Special Attacks
content: The first hit triggers a non-stacking effect determined by the last Basic Attack landed, whiffed or charged, each lasting 22 seconds.
Light: inflict a Heal Block Debuff.
Medium: gain a Steadfast Passive.
Heavy: inflict a 250 Energy Vulnerability Debuff.
While at 16 or more Maniacal Charges, Hobgoblin's Special Attacks become Passively Unblockable and the first hit triggers all of these effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Winged Mischief
content: Each hit grants +2 Maniacal Charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Death from Above
content: The final three hits each inflict a [12,466.25] Incinerate Passive for 20 seconds, with +20% base potency per Maniacal Charge
At the end of this attack, consume 50% of Maniacal Charges, rounded up. Afterwards, regain 2 Charges if Lunatic Laugh is active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Bomb Voyage
content: The concussive force of Hobgoblin's giant Pumpkin Bomb inflicts a Stun Debuff for 3 seconds.
Inflict a non-stacking [59,838] Incinerate Passive for 20 seconds.
Gain +8 Maniacal Charges.
